name: iitd-mail
title_zh: IITD 校园邮箱专属的 IMAP/SMTP 信使
tagline_zh: 在 Gmail 里永远搜不到的那封导师邮件，它替你从 IITD 服务器翻出来。发信前必问，删信前必问。
tagline_en: Finds faculty emails that never reach Gmail. Asks before send/delete. Never touches your personal inbox.
desc_en: IIT Delhi CSE IMAP/SMTP. Use iitd_mail_* tools only. Search, fetch, send, reply, trash, classify. Never Gmail. Ask before send/delete.
why_zh: 把校园邮箱协议封装成六个动作，搜索/取信/回信/归档各归其位。内置防误发闸门，所有写操作先过你这一关。
why_en: Six protocol actions, each with a guardrail. Writes always pause for your approval—no silent sends or trashes.
limit_zh: 只连 IIT Delhi CSE 的 IMAP/SMTP；其他学校或机构邮箱一概不认。
limit_en: Only IIT Delhi CSE IMAP/SMTP. Requires campus network/VPN access. Attachments saved to local temp only—no cloud sync.
